name: The Achiever
description: You are action- and result-oriented and focus on the tasks ahead, where performance and productivity are key. You are verbally and socially skilled. You enjoy problem-solving and have high achievement needs. You are good at balancing authority and compassion. You are able to create a favorable environment at your workplace. You focus on every detail of your task and expect the same from others. Your approach to life is optimistic, and you focus on possibilities even in difficult situations. You accept your failures and work towards success.

name: The Enthusiast
description: You are super creative and fun-loving. You look for all the possibilities and love working on new ideas. You can fill the room with laughter and the desire to live life on your own terms. You are always curious to learn new things and believe in enjoying your life. You can be described as someone who is "full of energy" and life. You are always on the go to create something new and interesting.

name: The Logical
description: You are an analyst and a critical thinker. You tend to focus on the minute details. You make decisions based on facts and proof. You know how to detach yourself from biases and observe all the information. You are a practical and self-motivated person. You have intellect, and people like you for your fair decision-making. You communicate effectively and observe the situation as a whole. You can be described as a "practical" and "fair" person

name: The Empath
description: You like listening to others’ issues. You are a person with a big heart who is sensitive to others’ emotions. You look at things from various perspectives. You seek pleasure in helping and understanding others’. You create a harmonious environment wherever you go and believe in spreading happiness. Making this world a better place is your ultimate goal. You are a peace lover. You can sense others’ energy and look forward to helping them. You can describe yourself as a "supporter" or "helper".

name: The Enthusiast and Achiever
description: You are the one who works hard to achieve the goals and likes to offer help and suggestions to others. You are someone who can be described as action- and goal-oriented. You are adaptable to the situation. You go extra miles to check the results and value relationships. You believe in creating new ideas and working on your own terms.

name: The Achiever and Logical
description: You have high intellect. Your main aim in life is to be successful. You are broad-minded and respect everyone’s opinion. You look for facts and figures before coming to any conclusions. You believe in working hard for your goals. You believe in doing and not just saying. You believe in inspiring others through your unbiased and practical approach.

name: The Achiever and Empath
description: You are a compassionate person. You have a high need for achievement and are goal-oriented. Nonetheless, you try to understand other people's perspectives and make decisions that are in everyone's best interests. As a person, you can be described as a great leader and a humble person.

name: The Enthusiast and Empath
description: You can be described as someone who believes in helping others and adding something beautiful to their lives. You believe in enjoying life and creating new ideas. You are creative by nature and like working with people. You are sensitive by nature and possess good listening skills. You also initiate the process of understanding people and ideas. Emotions play a very important role in your life.

name: The Empath and Logical
description: You are someone who can be described as having a combination of understanding and focus. You analyze everything deeply, whether it is people or situations, and then act accordingly. You like discussing ideas and facts. You do what is fair and believe in working on yourself. You have a high level of focus on your goals and lifting others up.

name: The Enthusiast and Logical
description: You are practical by nature, although you look for creative ideas to complete your task. People around you can describe you as someone who is unbiased and makes fair decisions. Your rule in life is clear, and you work on your own principles. You know how to separate your personal and professional lives. You always look for evidence before making any decision.
